retiredFamilies.reason: Open-hole and hollow-card hard veto at both required obliques; worst score 0.05.
The sole correction improved the worst score from 0.50 to 0.62, but the rose-first hierarchy and phone-scale doorway readability remained below the 0.85 gate.
Worst score 0.08. Materials-off exposed a full-height rectangular sheet; materials-on showed hard paper edges, a detached projection, cyan fringe, and no countable attached 3D bays.

Immutable r02 passed 26/26 integrity, but worst score was 0.18. The facade collapsed into planar shards at 315 degrees, the rose disk protruded at side/rear angles, front details detached, and the whole silhouette drifted into an onion-dome fort archetype.

Immutable r01 passed 26/26 integrity and was closed/card-free, but worst score was 0.22. It remained a generic low-poly keep with broad blank ochre slabs, isolated hex collars, unclear front bays, lamp-like drips, weak side/rear civic authorship, and no delicious glossy honey read.

Immutable r01 passed integrity with zero mismatches, but worst score was 0.18. The family triggered generic beehive-mound and cardboard-honey vetoes and failed source identity, continuous civic tracery, four-bay clarity, and phone identity.

The corrected headless Blender draft remained a pale toy-castle/tiered-cylinder composition with unclear front bays, blank rear mass, and awning-like honey. Its one bounded correction was used; no immutable evidence or runtime integration was created.

Unfrozen P0-P7 draft was watertight at 61,460 triangles and passed dimensional ratios, but front landmark RMS was 6.552% versus the 3% maximum. Hard vetoes were blank central drum, cylindrical toy-castle silhouette, open/card-like bay mouths, weak portal hierarchy, and blank side/rear massing.
